author: Traditionally Moses
authorNote: Jewish and Christian tradition names Moses. Many modern scholars think the five books of the Law were drawn together from several sources over centuries, reaching their final form around the 6th–5th century BC; others defend substantial Mosaic authorship.
date: Traditionally c. 1400s BC; final form debated (see Genesis)
overview: Israel is counted and sets out from Sinai towards the promised land. But the people grumble, rebel and refuse to enter the land when their spies report giants. As a result, a whole generation wanders in the wilderness for forty years, while God still guides and provides for them.
storyPlace: The journey between Sinai and the edge of the promised land.
